maddeler.e:
نتكاتب (form VI)
# نَتَكَاتَبُ (natakātabu) /na.ta.kaː.ta.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَاتَبَ (takātaba)
# نَتَكَاتَبَ (natakātaba) /na.ta.kaː.ta.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَاتَبَ (takātaba)
# نَتَكَاتَبْ (natakātab) /na.ta.kaː.tab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَاتَبَ (takātaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
